sn52.1:1.1: tatra vagguddānaṃ: iddhipāde cāpāla pāsādakampanayoguḷā gaṅgāpeyyāla ādīhi pañcahi vaggo hontaṭṭhāti.
sn52.1:1.2: 8. anuruddhasaṃyuttaṃ 1. rahogatavaggo 8. 1. 1. rahogatasuttaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā anuruddho sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn52.1:1.3: atha kho āyasmato anuruddhassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
sn52.1:1.4: “yesaṃ kesañci cattāro satipaṭṭhānā viraddhā, viraddho tesaṃ ariyo maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
sn52.1:1.5: yesaṃ kesañci cattāro satipaṭṭhānā āraddhā, āraddho tesaṃ ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī”ti.
sn52.1:2.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno āyasmato anuruddhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya, seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evamevaṃ āyasmato anuruddhassa pamukhe pāturahosi.
sn52.1:2.2: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca:
sn52.1:2.3: “kittāvatā nukho, āvuso anuruddha, bhikkhuno cattāro satipaṭṭhānā āraddhā hontī”ti?
sn52.1:3.1: idhāvuso bhikkhu ajjhattaṃ kāye samudayadhammānupassī viharati, ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. ajjhattaṃ kāye vayadhammānupassī viharati, …pe… ajjhattaṃ kāye samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati, ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.1:3.2: bahiddhā kāye samudayadhammānupassī viharati …pe… bahiddhā kāye vayadhammānupassī viharati …pe… bahiddhā kāye samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati, ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.1:3.3: ajjhattabahiddhā kāye samudayadhammānupassī viharati …pe… ajjhattabahiddhā kāye vayadhammānupassī viharati …pe… ajjhattabahiddhā kāye samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati, ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.1:4.1: so sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti, paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
